clue.text: Fairly occasionally pursuing choice of words, you may find the answer here

definitions.text: you may find the answer here

indicators.note: pursuing means coming after, so these letters follow the first piece

parts.note: diction is a speaker's or writer's choice of words

indicators.note: occasionally signals taking only every other letter of fairly, here the even ones

explanation.surface: Someone hunting for the right words is told where the solution can be looked up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The answer' looks like this clue's solution, but it is any answer at all: the definition is a reference book, so the clue is self-referential.
explanation.definitionFit: A reference book listing words with meanings is where a solver checks any crossword solution.

indicators.note: overturned in a down clue means turned upside down, so the word reads backwards

parts.note: meed is an old word for a reward or due

explanation.surface: A judge's award must be reversed on appeal.
explanation.definitionFit: To deem is to judge or consider something to be so.

clue.text: Call is contemptible, without route to the north

indicators.note: in a down clue to the north means going upwards, so the remainder reads backwards
without means lacking, so the route is removed

parts.note: pathetic means miserably contemptible
a path is a route

explanation.surface: Someone dismisses a call as contemptible, having no route north.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking PATH from PATHETIC leaves ETIC, which reads upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: To cite is to summon, call someone to appear in court.

indicators.note: uncovered means the outer letters of pest are stripped off

explanation.surface: An unwelcome creature lurking in a church that has been exposed.
explanation.definitionFit: To inch is to move very slowly, a little at a time, like creeping.

clue.text: Analysis of perhaps local crisis in government initially

parts.note: a local anaesthetic is something that numbs, a numb-er; perhaps marks it as an example
a crunch is a crisis or critical moment

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of government

explanation.surface: A report on a local crisis in government.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Local' looks like a pub or council; it is a local anaesthetic, which numbs.
explanation.definitionFit: Number-crunching is laborious statistical calculation, the analysis of data.

parts.note: Reno in Nevada is a famous gambling city

indicators.note: fleeced means shorn, so dire loses its outer letters

explanation.surface: A dire artist cleaned out in a casino town.
explanation.definitionFit: Pierre-Auguste Renoir was a French Impressionist painter.

parts.note: O is the cricket scoring abbreviation for an over
chessmen or draughtsmen are pieces in a board game

explanation.surface: A notice about some items or fragments, read as a terse instruction.
explanation.definitionFit: A portent is a sign of something to come, good or bad.

indicators.note: suspect means dubious or not genuine, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Wondering whether Tamara will suspect a broad principle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'General rule' reads as a principle; here it is government by army generals, hence the question mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Martial law is military government imposed in place of civil authority, rule by generals.

clue.text: Important fashion backed by online celebrity?

indicators.note: by means next to, so the pieces sit side by side
backed means turned back, so the word reads in reverse

parts.note: ton is an old word for fashion or high society
E as in e-mail stands for electronic or online
a worthy is a notable or eminent person

explanation.surface: An influencer's fashion is backed by an internet star.
explanation.definitionFit: Something noteworthy is significant, deserving of attention.

clue.text: Clementine cooked with bit of thyme for large carrot

indicators.note: cooked means prepared or doctored, so the letters are reworked
for here means in place of, so one letter stands in for another

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

indicators.note: a bit of the word thyme is its first letter

explanation.surface: A recipe: a clementine cooked with thyme instead of something large.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the L in CLEMENTINE for T, the first bit of thyme, giving CTEMENTINE, then 'cooked' rearranges it. 'Carrot' is the reward dangled, not a vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: A carrot, as in carrot and stick, is an inducement or lure offered to persuade someone.

indicators.note: shortened means the word loses its final letter

parts.note: a rite is a ceremony

explanation.surface: A legal paper drawn up in connection with an abbreviated ceremony.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal written court order is a legal document that lawyers serve.

clue.text: What beat demonstrates in instantaneous recital

definitions.meaning: first meaning: tan (to beat) occurs twice running in the word instantaneous, a repeat
second meaning: a recitation or retelling, as of something learnt

explanation.walkthrough: Look inside insTANTANeous: TAN, meaning beat, appears twice running.
explanation.definitionFit: Repetition means saying something again or reciting it, as well as recurring.

clue.text: Second from highest into arranging picnic

parts.note: of can mean from, as in made of
the top is the highest point

indicators.note: arranging means putting in a new order, so the letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: Coming second, moving up into organising a picnic.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Picnic' is the definition: no picnic means hard work.
explanation.definitionFit: An easy course of action is informally called a picnic, something requiring little effort.

clue.text: Fed up about the setter's flipping fault

indicators.note: flipping means turning over, so the whole result is read backwards
about means surrounding, so the setter is placed inside

parts.note: fed up means tired, having lost patience
the setter refers to themself as me; the 's is the setter is

explanation.surface: An exasperated setter, annoyed and cursing about some flaw.
explanation.walkthrough: TIRED goes 'about' ME to give TIREMED, and 'flipping' reverses it all. 'Flipping' reads like a mild curse.
explanation.definitionFit: A demerit is a black mark or failing, a point counting against someone.

clue.text: Hardy stuntman loses nothing embracing artist

indicators.note: embracing means holding, so the artist is put inside
loses means one letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: a stuntman stands in as an actor's double
O is the zero digit, nothing
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A tough stuntman embracing an artist, with Hardy hinting at a famous actor or author.
explanation.walkthrough: DOUBLE 'loses' O, giving DUBLE, which goes 'embracing' RA.
explanation.definitionFit: Hardy and durable both mean tough and long-lasting, able to withstand wear.

indicators.note: almost means the word stops short, losing its last letter

parts.note: to teach is to guide or instruct
ups are raises, as in pay rises

explanation.surface: A guide nearly lifts some boats.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vessels' suggests ships; here they are cups.
explanation.definitionFit: Teacups are small drinking vessels, containers for tea.

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the second book of the Old Testament
second meaning: a mass going out or leaving

explanation.definitionFit: Exodus is both the Bible book of the Israelites leaving Egypt and any large-scale emigration.

parts.note: re means regarding or concerning
a view is a sight, how something appears

explanation.surface: A critic's assessment of how something looks.
explanation.definitionFit: A critical assessment of a book, play or film is published as a critique.

clue.text: Further notice about ancient city when river moves beyond set course

parts.note: extra means further or additional

indicators.note: moves means one letter shifts its place within the word
about means surrounding, so the notice is placed around the city

parts.note: a circular is a notice sent round to many people
Ur is the ancient Mesopotamian city
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A further notice about an ancient city when a river changes course.
explanation.walkthrough: Ur is the Sumerian city of the Bible's Abraham. 'Set course' reads as a river's path; it is a school syllabus.
explanation.definitionFit: Extracurricular activities lie outside the regular syllabus or curriculum of a school.

clue.text: Antelope claiming to be your best friend?

definitions.text: claiming to be your best friend?
definitions.meaning: second meaning, punning: split the answer as ..., a claim to be your pal

explanation.walkthrough: Break the antelope's name into 2, 3 and 1 letters and it reads as 'I'm pal a', someone insisting on friendship.
explanation.definitionFit: The impala is a graceful reddish-brown African grazing animal, a species of antelope.

indicators.note: in means the letters sit inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: A small military base in the Irish town of Dundalk.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Base' suggests a camp; it is the chemistry sense.
explanation.definitionFit: An alkali is a chemical base that dissolves in water, the opposite of an acid.

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the place goes within the band

parts.note: a sash is a band of cloth worn round the body
PL is the street-name abbreviation for place

explanation.surface: A newspaper editor working out where a headline sits within a strip.
explanation.definitionFit: To splash a story is to give it a prominent front-page heading, and a splash is that big story.

indicators.note: in audition means as heard, so the word that sounds the same is wanted

parts.note: a step is a movement of the foot

explanation.surface: A plain dance move done at a try-out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Audition' looks like a dancer's try-out; it means hearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A steppe is a vast treeless grassland, as in Russia or Central Asia.

clue.text: Ecstasy legal, end of dubious extracts

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy
licit means lawful

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of the word dubious

explanation.surface: A debate over whether ecstasy should be legal, ending on a doubtful note.
explanation.definitionFit: To elicit is to draw out a response or information from someone.

parts.note: I is the map abbreviation for island

indicators.note: brought back means turned round, so the title is read backwards

parts.note: sir is the title of a gentleman or knight

explanation.surface: A man on an island bringing a specimen home.
explanation.definitionFit: The iris is a flowering garden plant with sword-shaped leaves.

indicators.note: omits means leaves out, so the letters are removed

parts.note: a beadle is a minor parish or ceremonial official
le is French for the

explanation.surface: An official leaves out the French in some drop.
explanation.definitionFit: A bead is a small drop of liquid, such as a bead of sweat.

indicators.note: performing means acting up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The best performer in the performing arts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Performing arts' reads as one phrase; 'performing' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A star is a celebrated lead entertainer or headliner.

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

indicators.note: badly means messed up, so the letters of the word are scrambled

explanation.surface: Dad has made a hash of the spelling in a handwritten document.
explanation.definitionFit: A palimpsest is a parchment page written on again after earlier text was scraped off.

clue.text: A square located in Rimini neighbourhood

indicators.note: located in means the letters sit within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A town square in an Italian resort's district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A square' looks like a piazza in Rimini; it is a number.
explanation.definitionFit: Nine is three times three, a square number.

clue.text: Lecturer catches Heather cycling, the main cause of trouble

indicators.note: catches means grasps, so one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: a reader is a senior university lecturer in Britain

indicators.note: cycling means the first letter goes round to the end

parts.note: ling is another name for heather

explanation.surface: A lecturer catches someone called Heather on a bike, the source of all the bother.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain a reader is a senior academic rank just below professor. Heather looks like a name; it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A ringleader is the instigator who leads others in mischief or crime.
